notices.plain: The Conflicts of Interest Board has adopted new rules, according to a notice published Jan. 7, 2026.
The Campaign Finance Board has scheduled a public comment period on its voter guide assistance services, published Jan. 7, 2026.
The Office of Chief Medical Examiner is holding a public comment period on a contract award for Nifty Concepts to deliver high-risk gloves, as listed in a notice published Jan. 7, 2026.

notices.short_title: NY 15/15 Contract _ Congregate Supportive Housing _ The Jericho Project
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene is holding a public comment period on a proposed contract with The Jericho Project for congregate supportive housing under the NY 15/15 program.
The Administration for Children's Services awarded Chapin Hall Center for Children a $900,000 contract for analytical technical assistance, chosen from competing proposals.
The Department for the Aging renewed its home care services contract with People Care Inc. in a deal worth $19,149,145.
The Office of Chief Medical Examiner awarded NicheVision Forensics LLC a $778,347 sole-source contract for annual upgrade and maintenance services, with only that one vendor considered.

The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Savvy Business Inc a $45,000 contract for sandbags through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business made without competition.

The Department of Correction awarded Maureen Data Systems, Inc. a $29,700 contract for Guardian 45 devices and software through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business, made without competition.

The Department of Correction awarded Lebron 2015 Equipment Supply Corp a $30,475 contract for 25 mobile shelves with racks, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: IT consulting for IT Development & Management Project
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded RCI Technologies Inc a $580,000 contract for IT consulting for an IT development and management project, buying through a contract another government already holds.

The Department of Design and Construction awarded T R Joy & Associates Inc a $387,725 contract for an electronic security system, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.short_title: EC-SEQS26 - RECONSTRUCTION OF EXISTING SEWERS, SOUTH QUEENS
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction awarded Apache Environmental & Development LLC a $11.4 million contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, to reconstruct existing sewers in South Queens.
The Employees' Retirement System awarded Compulink Technologies Inc. a contract worth $132,699.20 for Atlassian goods and services, using a contract change.

notices.short_title: Bid Extension: 82626B0029-BEDC-OH-88: Owls Head WWTP Final Settling System Rehabilitation
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking construction bids, through a pre-qualified list of vendors, for rehabilitation of the Owls Head wastewater treatment plant's final settling system, with responses due March 19, 2026.

notices.short_title: BWS Removal, Transport, Dispose of Waste 6016000X
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded ENP Environmental Inc a $678,664 contract for removing, transporting and disposing of waste, using a small-purchase method that let a certified minority- or women-owned business win without competition.

notices.short_title: Bid Extension: 82626B0017-BEDC-KENS-EAST-SS Kensico-Eastview Connection Shoreline Stabilization
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection extended the bid deadline to March 13, 2026, for a construction project to stabilize the shoreline at the Kensico-Eastview Connection, with competition limited to pre-qualified vendors.

notices.vendor_name: New York State Industries for the Disabled Inc
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded New York State Industries for the Disabled Inc. an $86,135 contract for professional cleaning services, selected as a required source.

notices.short_title: Occupational Health Dynamics (OHD) QuantiFit2 Respirator Fit Testing Instruments
notices.plain: The Fire Department awarded Avco Enterprises Dentserve a $76,771 contract, without competitive bidding, for Occupational Health Dynamics QuantiFit2 respirator fit testing instruments.

The Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications renewed its citywide system integration contract with Accenture LLP for up to $50 million, continuing services under the Citywide System Integration Class 3 contract.
The New York City Police Department awarded Spruce Technology Inc a $577,379 contract, without competitive bidding, to lease, maintain and support Ricoh printers.

The Department of Sanitation awarded Goldman Copeland Associates Engineers DPC a contract of $5 million for citywide architectural and engineering design services for fiscal years 2025 through 2029, chosen from competing proposals.

The Taxi and Limousine Commission awarded Quality and Assurance Technology Corp a $394,380 contract for technical project manager consulting services, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

The Taxi and Limousine Commission awarded Awe-Huh Creative Services LLC a $32,000 contract for aluminum medallion fabrication through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.
The Board of Correction will hold a public meeting on Jan. 13, 2026.
